25kW Three-Phase Inverter

PCS Price (Clearance RESI): RM 16.59/pcs (¥28.54/pcs)

Formula: Clearance RESI per kW × 25 kW/pcs

PCS Cost: RM 8.8023/pcs (¥15.1400/pcs)

Avg Cost: RM 0.3521/kW (¥0.6056/kW; base cost)

Clearance Cost: ¥0.6056 × (1 + 20% duty + 10% SST) = ¥0.7873

Grey Cost: ¥0.6056 × (1 + 5% grey tax) = ¥0.6359

RESI Price: cost × (1 + 45% total company margin) = +45.00%

C&I Price: cost × (1 + 45% total company margin) = +45.00%

Market 30D: No 30-day market price

FX: 1 MYR = 1.7200 CNY

Certifications: IEC 62109-1, IEC 62109-2, IEC 62477 (when applicable), IEC 62109-1/2, SIRIM / local utility requirements where applicable
